reference.method: Median strongest-50ms RMS of the live game's six existing melee/bow cues, including the game master gain. Match toward that digital output at the board's 55% reference volume. Other volume settings scale normally. Current game cues reproduce their original relative gains; base/library profiles of authored quiet edits retain zero makeup gain. Event-specific attack and ordinary-terrain gains may adjust these to their corresponding game range.
reference.eventRangePolicy: Clamp attack and ordinary-terrain events to their existing game min/max strongest-50ms RMS ranges; retain gains already in range. Quarry/mine and bell tiles retain their authored levels. Selection and shared movement are unchanged.

method: Context-specific attack/terrain gains clamp toward their existing game ranges, overriding quiet-edit preservation only for those events. Other contexts retain the base profile. Constant gain per decoded take/full session. Target strongest 50ms RMS subject to sample-peak ceiling; no compressor, no true-peak or perceptual loudness guarantee. Base/library profiles of authored quiet edits keep zero gain; archived game samples retain their relative base game gain at the board reference volume.
